subject: Request: incident log sampling & sanitized evidence for FinBridge latency escalation
messages:
From: Michael Torres <mtorres@finbridge.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: ops@finbridge.com
Date: Mon, 29 Nov 2027 11:12:00 -0800
Subject: Severe latency + 5xx spike during overnight payout window

Hannah —

We saw a sustained latency increase (~3-4x p50/p95) and a spike in 5xx errors that coincided with our overnight payout batch (00:30–01:20 PT). About ~12% of requests failed with 502/504. This impacted settlement confirmation messages and triggered downstream retries.

Can you confirm what logs you can provide from the 00:00–02:00 PT window? We need request traces, any token-level failure messages, and confirmation that no customer PII was exposed in traces.

We will need a short evidence packet for our ops and legal teams by EOD tomorrow. Please advise on retention and redaction options.

Attaching our incident timeline snapshot (finbridge_incident_timeline.csv) for reference.

Thanks,
Michael
Ops Lead, FinBridge

--- Attachment: finbridge_incident_timeline.csv (csv, 7kb)

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Michael Torres <mtorres@finbridge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 29 Nov 2027 11:35:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Severe latency + 5xx spike during overnight payout window

Thanks Michael — I’m escalating this to the runtime and incident teams now. We’ve opened SUP-4721 and will scope the immediate evidence packet. Initial asks from your message: 00:00–02:00 PT window, request traces, and confirmation about PII exposure.

Quick plan:
- Aditya: collect request-level traces, token trace snippets, and continuous-batching logs (including kernel switch events).
- David: pull autoscaler/queueing metrics and per-host GPU telemetry for the timeframe.
- I’ll coordinate with Marissa on executive/contract questions and with our legal team for any formal legal hold.

Question for FinBridge: do you need full request payloads or a redacted/sampled set? If legal prefers, we can provide sanitized traces (replace user identifiers with stable hashes) and a separate chain-of-custody statement.

Target: deliver a sanitized evidence packet (for ops + legal) by 2027-11-30 17:00 PT. If you need earlier, flag it here and we’ll prioritize.

Hannah
Senior Manager, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference

--- Note: creating SUP-4721; will attach evidence template in follow-up.

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>, Michael Torres <mtorres@finbridge.com>

Subject: Re: Severe latency + 5xx spike during overnight payout window

On Mon, Nov 29, 2027 at 11:35 AM Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Quick plan:

I ran an initial triage against the runtime logs for the 00:15–01:40 PT subset and saw a spike in queueing delay on one of the dedicated pools we serve FinBridge on (dedicated-pool-us-west-2-a). There were a handful of kernel fallbacks (float32 -> int8 path) logged that line up with increased token-latency for long sequences.

What I can produce within the next 6 hours:
- Sampled token-trace snippets (max 200 requests) with token-level latency metrics and error codes (we can pseudonymize identifiers). Attached: kvcache-sample-20271129.jsonl (sample).
- Per-request metadata CSV (request_id, model_variant, start_ts, end_ts, error_code) — we’ll include request-level UUIDs, not user IDs.
- Runtime host telemetry (GPU temp, mem utilization, scheduling stalls) aggregated at 1s resolution.

Retention notes: our runtime stores continuous logs for 90 days by default, and higher-fidelity token traces are kept for 30 days unless a legal hold is placed. We can export older snapshots if required by Customer SLA / legal.

PII / redaction: we will by default replace any user identifiers and email addresses with hashed tokens unless FinBridge legal requests the raw payloads under a signed NDA and approved data access process.

Attaching a short token trace snippet for context.

Aditya
Senior Software Engineer, Serving Runtime
--- Attachment: kvcache-sample-20271129.jsonl (jsonl, 18kb)
--- Attachment: token_traces_snippet.txt (txt, 6kb)

Hannah/Aditya/David — please include a short chain-of-custody statement and a bulleted list of what we’re delivering (exact filenames + hash of each file). I’ll coordinate the SLA/deal-related notes (DB-8981) and whether FinBridge expects credits for the outage window.

Marissa
